requirement: Production secrets must not be included in evaluator packages
Private engine must not expose public network endpoints
Gateway-to-engine transport requires signed internal context
Health probes must not disclose infrastructure credentials or topologies
Security incidents and anomalies must trigger containment and audit records
Every personal data processing activity must have an owner and documented purpose
Data flows must strictly match service integrations with no undocumented egress
Cross-tenant privacy requests must be strictly denied at repository layer
Deletion workflow must cascade to primary storage
Data retention policies must be automatically enforced by scheduled purge routines
Downloadable client and backend engine must generate distinct verified SBOMs
Third-party dependencies must have explicit reviewed notices and attribution
Model provider credentials must remain server-side with zero client exposure
Third-party suppliers must have documented data retention and training terms
Supplier exit and data-deletion procedures must be documented and tested
Backup restoration must preserve revocation state and not resurrect revoked licenses
Policy versions and effective approvals must be tracked and non-stale
All compliance evidence must be traceable to git commit SHA and artifact digest
Documented exceptions must have approved owners and non-expired time horizons
Final release gate must require independent review and approval
